extensionAttribute.description: Reports the active pmset profile (e.g. "Battery Power", "AC Power", "UPS Power"). pmset marks the active profile with an asterisk.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Active Power Management Profile Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # pmset -g lists profile sections; the currently active one is prefixed # with "*". We strip that marker and trailing colon for a clean label.
profile=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk '/^\*/ { sub(/^\*[[:space:]]*/, ""); sub(/:$/, ""); print; exit }')
echo "<result>${profile:-Unknown}</result>"
